summary: Ansible cannot run on Windows as a control node because of platform API limits. You can run it through WSL or in a container, but WSL is not supported and shouldn't be used in production.
questions: Can I install Ansible on my Windows laptop as the control node?
Is running Ansible under WSL supported for production?
How can I use Ansible if my workstation runs Windows?

answer_card.title: Running Ansible from a Windows machine
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible can't run natively on Windows as the control node because of API limitations. Options:
- Run it in the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).
- Run it in a container.

Note: WSL is **not supported** by Ansible and shouldn't be used for production systems.
